status_at_recording: S001 EDF parser checked for dimensions, channels and labels. No PhysioNet classifier predictions or evaluation metrics inspected.
cohort: Consecutive first 12 PhysioNet EEGMMIDB IDs S001 through S012. Limited for download time; unrelated to accuracy. All individuals are included if records pass checks.
primary_model: Subject-specific CSP + shrinkage LDA, fixed after the BNCI model comparison
window: 0 to 3 s after cue; exclude annotation if shorter than 3 s or requested samples extend beyond EOF
eligibility: Each selected run must have both labels; no exclusions for low individual accuracy. Report any missing or incomplete run.
scope: Independent verification of a personalized MI method after target-person training on two preceding runs. Single modality. No across-dataset transfer of fitted parameter values.
